programme.title: Forensic Files: The Financial Downfall
programme.desc: A beautiful young woman falls to her death from a cliff overlooking the ocean. Initially, investigators think it was a tragic accident. But after a forensic examination, police uncover a very different picture of what happened.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Haunted by the disappearance of her mother, a young woman undertakes an investigation of her own. In her mother's diary, she discovers a dark family secret that might explain the disappearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Over a Barrel
programme.desc: California police had several suspects in the robbery and brutal murder of an elderly couple. Ten years later, a determined forensic scientist used material from a dentist's office to uncover ballistic evidence that had been overlooked.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pinned by the Evidence
programme.desc: After a street fight takes the life of a national wrestling champion, police must determine if he was killed in cold blood or in self-defense.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cries Unheard
programme.desc: A 19-year-old woman was found dead in her car; the scene had been staged to make murder appear to be suicide. During their investigation, police discovered the victim was involved in a love quadrangle, giving several people a motive to kill her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Buried Treasure
programme.desc: A man disappears one year to the day after beginning an affair with his friend's wife. 15 years later, with the help of a metal detector, police find evidence that would prove what had happened and who was responsible.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Badge of Betrayal
programme.desc: When the body of a young woman is found under an isolated highway ramp, a unique fiber on the victim's clothing leads San Diego police straight to the most unlikely of killers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Matrimony
programme.desc: A go-go dancer told her family she needed to get away for a while and then she simply disappeared. Investigators were suspicious, because she took neither her car nor her clothes. 20 years later, her family received a call that changed everything.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Muddy Waters
programme.desc: A Colorado hunter is the victim of a well-planned crime. Investigators suspect two weapons and two killers. But forensic evidence points them in a different direction — one much closer to home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Point of Origin
programme.desc: In 1984, California firefighters battled ten arson fires in three weeks. When cigarettes and a scrap of paper connected the case to similar fires further north, the hunt was on for a dangerous pyromaniac.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover
programme.desc: Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Killing Zone
programme.desc: In the 1990's the war on drugs was in full swing. The front lines were often America's inner cities where gangs use violence and murder to rule their empires.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Business
programme.desc: Many escape the poverty of India to start new lives in the United States. One turned the American dream into a nightmare. People started turning up dead in New York's Indian community-authorities struggled to link fraud and murder to a powerful man.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The C-11 Squad
programme.desc: New York City is not stranger to gang violence. But when a 12-year-old child was kidnapped, the gangs had crossed a line. Law enforcement raced to find the missing boy before it was too late.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Soldier Stories
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Infallible Witness
programme.desc: Investigators are always on the cutting edge of new forensic techniques that can help them solve cases more accurately. An experimental "brain fingerprinting" technique has already won the acquittal of a police officer accused of a drug charge.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Traces Of Guilt
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence: a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Chemistry
programme.desc: The show examines cases of poison and deadly chemistry and shows how forensic experts are solving mysterious deaths today and from the past.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scattered Clues
programme.desc: There's never a good reason for murder, but some killers are particularly brutalchoosing their prey at random or with no apparent motive and then cunningly covering their tracks. Even so, telltale clues remain.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Point of No Return
programme.desc: When a mysterious explosion rocks a sleepy suburb, it’s up to Kenda to ID a pile of charred remains and find the killer who triggered the blast.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Murder Bites
programme.desc: A young woman is found naked and strangled in a park not 200 yards from her home. It isn’t until Lt. Joe Kenda rethinks the entire case that he realizes someone has been lying.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Invisible Hand of Death
programme.desc: Two teens stumble upon a woman engulfed in flames, leaving detectives to wonder just who in her inner circle could kill so cruelly.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Shallow Grave
programme.desc: Lt. Joe Kenda and his team investigate the scene of an apparent suicide, only to be forced to flee when they discover the house is booby-trapped.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Human Animal
programme.desc: The naked body of a vibrant young mother is found frozen solid in a deserted cemetery. Kenda reopens the investigation and recognizes the sinister hallmark of a serial killer.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Race, The Hubble, Chasing Comets & Space Debris
programme.desc: Cold War & The Start of the Space Race - Cold War rivalry and the acceleration of space exploration. Servicing Hubble - Preparations for Hubble's final servicing mission. Chasing a Comet - Launch and the difficult path to rendezvous.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System
programme.desc: Project Mercury Begins - The start of NASA & America's first manned space program. Mars Express - The European Space Agency's Mars Satellite. The Soyuz Launch System - The gradual evolution of Russia's Soyuz launcher.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury Advancement, Camera Tracking & The International Space Station
programme.desc: Project Mercury Advances - America's first manned space program finally puts a man in orbit. Camera Tracking - The array of special cameras that follow a spacecraft at launch. The International Space Station - The building and operation.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini, Venus Express, EMU & Deep Space Communication
programme.desc: Project Gemini Commences - Did Gemini give the US a lead in the space race? Venus Express - The last days of ESA's Venus probe. EMU - NASA's Extravehicular Mobility Unit. Deep Space Communications - ESA's worldwide network of giant dishes.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini Advances, Cassini at Saturn & More About Mars
programme.desc: Project Gemini Advances - NASA refines the techniques needed for rendezvous. Cassini at Saturn - In the Cassini probe's final years of activity, its handlers are asking it to do more complex and risky assignments.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini Docking, Mars Curiousity & Satellite Swarms
programme.desc: Project Gemini: Docking and EVA - In the final phase of the Gemini program NASA struggles with docking and spacewalks. Curiosity Roving Mars - On the surface of Mars the Curiosity rover is changing the way we think about the red planet.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Superscopes
programme.desc: The human eye can only see visible light, a small spectrum of electromagnetic waves. Today, we have instruments that let us perceive all wavelengths.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 506
programme.desc: 26. januar 2001 ble Benjamin Hermansen knivstukket til døde som følge av sin hudfarge. Drapet fikk hele landet til å delta i antirasistiske markeringer og protester.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 507
programme.desc: 13. desember 2008 skjer det som omtales som den verste brannen i Oslo siden krigen, i Urtegata på Grønland. Det ble fort mistenkt at brannen var påsatt.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 508
programme.desc: Etter en fest i juli 2017 forsvinner Tom Rune Hagen. Han har vært en del av et belastet rusmiljø, men akkurat denne uka har han planlagt en tur på fjellet for å fiske. Hva skjedde med Tom Rune?

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 101
programme.desc: Anne Elisabeth Hagen forsvinner sporløst fra sitt hjem høsten 2018. På en rød stol finner ektemann og milliardær, Tom Hagen et trusselbrev og krav om løsepenger.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 102
programme.desc: Åtte år gamle Monika Sviglinskaja blir funnet død i sitt hjem på Sotra. Politiet mener det dreier seg om et selvmord og henlegger saken. Men moren hennes er fortsatt overbevist om at noe kriminelt har skjedd.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 103
programme.desc: To turgåere finner et utbrent lik på et bål langs en øde skogsbilvei på Veståsen i Søndre Land. I flere uker står politiet helt uten svar på hvem som kan stå bak den groteske handlingen.

programme.desc: Noen har sveipet fisk av båten til Cap'n Turbot, så han kaller på Ryder og PAW Patrol som hjelper ham i etterforskningen. // Ved hjelp av sitt nye spion utstyr, inspiserer Chase båten og under dekk oppdager han en gruppe Pingviner.

programme.desc: Paw Patrol planlegger en spesiell feiring av Wally. Når han ikke kommer, må de finne hans spesielle venn Walinda. // Under Cap'n Turbots arkeologiske utgraving kommer et dinosaurbein til syne etter et steinras.

programme.desc: Sam blir fornærmet når Freddie beskylder henne for ikke å betale ham og Carly noen av de pengene tilbake som hun konstant låner. Sam prøver iherdig å betale dem tilbake - hun finner seg en ordentlig jobb.

programme.title: iCarly: Hubert Lewbert
programme.desc: En "Lur Lewbert"-sketsj går helt galt og skader Carlys irriterende portvakt. Gjengen pleier ham inntil Freddies mor tar over. Men når kærligheten begynner å blomstre, må de sette en stopper for det.

programme.title: iCarly: Pie
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Spencer tar med Freddie til deres yndlingskonditori, finner de ut at eieren er død. Men enda verre er det at oppskriftene hans kanskje er gått tapt for alltid.

programme.title: iCarly: Jul
programme.desc: I et forsøk på å pifte opp julen med et utradisjonelt tre, kommer Spencer til å sette fyr på alle Carlys gaver. Fortvilet ønsker hun seg at hun hadde en normal bror.

programme.title: iCarly: Kysset
programme.desc: Sam overhører Freddie fortelle Carly at han aldri har kysset en jente, og avslører hemmeligheten hans på netshowet. Gibby og Carly trener Spencer til utttaket for det lokale, profesjonelle fotballaget.

programme.title: iCarly: Bilbråk
programme.desc: Gjengen holder en konkurranse på iCarly, og premien er en ny bil fra en lokal forhandler. Etter at Nevel vinner, oppdager barna at forhandleren ikke visste noe om konkurransen eller bilen de skulle ha donert bort som premie.

programme.title: iCarly: Fred
programme.desc: Freddie sier offentlig at han ikke er fan av internettsensasjonen Fred, noe som får Fred til å meddele at han skal slutte å legge ut filmer for alltid. Fansen blir rasende fordi Freddie har forårsaket slutten på de populære filmene.

programme.title: iCarly: Dobbelt opp
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie sniker seg ut for å dra til en MMA-kamp, får de sine dobbeltgjengere til å lure Spencer til å tro at de fortsatt er hjemme. Imens bygger Spencer en kjempeversjon av Newton Balls.

programme.title: iCarly: Om hva for noe?
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie oppfordrer iCarly-fans til å stemme på David Archuleta i "Amerika Sings", syns de synd på nummer to og hjelper ham med å lage en musikkvideo.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg skal gjøre Sam jentete
programme.desc: Da Sam innrømmer at hun liker en gutt på skolen, lærer Carly henne hvordan hun kan lokke ham til seg ved å oppføre seg mere feminint. Spencer er overbevist om at en jente liker ham pga. smokingen hans, så han går med den hele tiden.

programme.title: iCarly: A date en pøbel del 1
programme.desc: Når Carly dater er en tøffing, prøver hun å holde forholdet skjult for Spencer. Og Sam betaler Freddie for å lage en hjemmeside der hun kan legge ut alle sine ekle videofavoritter.

programme.title: Awkward: Let's Talk About Sex
programme.desc: Jennas far tar saken i egne hender for å få snakke med Mattys foreldre om deres barns forhold.

programme.title: Awkward: Indecent Exposure
programme.desc: Når Matty flytter inn hos Hamiltonfamilien, oppdager Jenna at samboerskap er mer enn det hun hadde regent med.

programme.title: Awkward: That Girl Strikes Again
programme.desc: Spøkelsene fra Jennas fortid kommer fram igjen, og det gjør også hennes usikkerhet - akkurat i tide til Halloweenfeiringen i Palos Hills.

programme.title: Awkward: Guilt Trippin'
programme.desc: Jennas første kavaler til Homecomingballet roter opp gamle skyldfølelser rundt jenta hun en gang var og jentene som ikke har kavalerer.

programme.title: Awkward: Rubbed Raw and Reeling
programme.desc: En utfordring fra Mr. Hart tvinger Jenna til å eksponere seg offentlig, og dermed konfronteres hun med noen alarmerende og nye innsikter i sin person.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Check
programme.desc: Etter en sen kaffe med Collin klarer ikke Jenna å slutte å tenke på ham, eller hva det betyr å være forelsket og det å ha en kjæreste.

programme.title: Awkward: Redefining Jenna
programme.desc: Spenningen stiger mellom Jenna og Matty når Collin inviterer henne til en snerten fotovisning hjemme hos ham selv.

programme.title: Awkward: Surprise!
programme.desc: Etter å ha klint med Collin på impuls, bestemmer Jenna seg for å slutte å være utro før Matty finner ut om det.

programme.title: Awkward: And Then What Happened
programme.desc: Hva skjedde egentlig på overraskelsesfesten - og er det virkelig helt slutt mellom Jenna og Matty? Det vet bare de to, men vennene deres prøver å finne ut sannheten.

programme.title: Awkward: Taking Sides
programme.desc: Jenna holder grillfest for at hennes venner skal venne seg til tanken på hennes og Collins spirende forhold. Men når deres støtte uteblir, tar hun drastiske midler i bruk.

programme.title: John Mellencamp MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: This one-hour episode with beloved American rocker John Mellencamp was taped in Los Angeles in April of 1992, and features a medley of Mellencamp hits, past and present.

programme.title: Elton John MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In this MTV Unplugged Special, one of the most extravagant rockstars hits the stage. This is Elton John Unplugged.

programme.title: Nirvana MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Nirvana's classic acoustic performance recorded at Sony Music Studios in New York City on November 18, 1993.

programme.title: Lady Gaga & Tony Bennett MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: This highly-anticipated episode of MTV Unplugged features Lady Gaga and Tony Bennett performing a combination of stripped-back duets and solo songs from their Grammy-nominated album, Love For Sale.

programme.title: Placebo MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In an intimate live performance, superstars demonstrate their skills with acoustic versions of their greatest hits. This episode features Placebo unplugged.

programme.title: The Roast of Alec Baldwin
programme.desc: Nå er det Alec Baldwins tur i den varme stolen, årets Roast Master er Sean Hayes, og blant de som roaster finner vi Robert De Niro, Caitlyn Jenner og Nikki Glaser.

programme.title: Another Period: Lillian's Wedding
programme.desc: Lillian vil gifte seg med en rik olding, Laverne. Gnistene flyr mellom Hortense og Lavernes kjekke barnebarn Bertram. Etter at avslørende bilder truer Fredericks stilling som visepresident, forviser han Beatrice fra Bellacourt Manor.

programme.title: Another Period: The Duel
programme.desc: Når Dodo mottar skilsmissepapirer, drar hun tilbake til Bellacourt for å ordne opp i sakene og utfordrer Chair til duell. Etter Lavernes død drukner Lillian sine sorger i alkohol, noe den nylig døpte Beatrice misliker sterkt.

programme.title: Another Period: Lillian is Dead
programme.desc: Hortense og Bertrams lykke viser seg å være kortlivet, så også Commodore og Chairs. Beatrice vender seg mot religionen når hennes slagsmål med Lillian får dødelige konsekvenser. Og nedenunder nedkommer Blanche med barn.

programme.title: Another Period: Roosevelt
programme.desc: Huset Commodore inviterer familien Roosevelt til Bellacourt Manor for å overbevise Teddy om å velge Frederick som visepresident. Lillian kaster blikket på FDR, Beatrice får en forbindelse med Eleanor. Peepers basker med en tjenerstreik.

programme.title: Detroiters: Pilot
programme.desc: Tim og Sam, to lavskala reklamemenn fra Detroit, prøver å få en stor kampanje med Chrysler, som ender i katastrofe. Ders assistent Lea påtar seg en badekar-reklame på egen hånd. Gjesteskuespiller Jason Sudeikis og Steve Higgins.

programme.title: Detroiters: Devereux Wigs
programme.desc: Tim og Sam forsøker å få en gammel Motown-legende til å synge en jingle i en reklame for et lokalt parykkfirma som de produserer, og Tim må forsone seg med sine sangferdigheter. Gjesteopptreden med George Wallace.

programme.title: Detroiters: Sam 'The Man'
programme.desc: Sam begynner å date en kvinne fra kommunestyret som tror han er prostituert. Tim og kona hans blir inspirert av Sams nye livsstil og prøver ut rollespill.

programme.desc: Alice antyder at noen skal bli forfremmet på jobben. Anders, Adam og Blake føler at de fortjener en forfremmelse og konkurrerer om den.

programme.desc: In 2002, a small community in upstate New York was devastated when Patty Wlasiuk died in a truck accident. But burdock seed pods found in her hair and on her clothes indicated that this was no accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Saving Face
programme.desc: When a woman disappeared without a trace, there were two possible explanations: kidnapping or murder. Careful investigation, a forensic artist and DNA profiling enabled police to find a single suspect, who was known to prey upon vulnerable women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Northern Exposure
programme.desc: Alaskan hikers discover a body wrapped in sheets which were edged in orange stitching. Investigators find a tuft of red carpet fibers clinging to the sheet — threads of evidence which lead them straight to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Silk Stalkings
programme.desc: Prompted by news of a flight attendant's brutal murder, the son of a previous victim contacts police. Both murders have similar MOs, and biological evidence proves that these were serial killings.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fishing for the Truth
programme.desc: A two-man shrimp boat sinks when a fast-moving, violent storm strikes the Louisiana coast. The captain drowns, but the deckhand is rescued fourteen hours later. The crewman is hailed as a hero — until the captain's body is discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: For Love or Money
programme.desc: When a wealthy real estate tycoon goes missing, it appears to be foul play. In his will, he leaves instructions in case he should die under violent circumstances — which were carried out after a hiker comes across his bullet-ridden skull.

programme.title: Forensic Files: South of the Border
programme.desc: The murder of an American tourist in a Mexican resort draws law enforcement resources on both sides of the border. At first glance, the motive appears to be robbery, but careful analysis of the forensic evidence points to something more sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Stake-Out
programme.desc: Police are led on a wild goose chase when the wife of a prominent banker is kidnapped. An entomologist's unexpected discovery leads to a new suspect — and the realization that ordinary office equipment can leave extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Walking Terror
programme.desc: A neighbor watched as a man stabbed his wife, pushed her into the swimming pool and held her head under water. The husband, however, had no recollection of the crime. A jury would have to decide between evidence and the mysteries of the mind.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The C-11 Squad
programme.desc: New York City is not stranger to gang violence. But when a 12-year-old child was kidnapped, the gangs had crossed a line. Law enforcement raced to find the missing boy before it was too late.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Master Plan
programme.desc: Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death In The Delta
programme.desc: When a wealthy young woman was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The 25-year-old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband and old boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In a small Ohio community, an elderly woman and a teenaged boy disappeared. Because they vanished within hours of each other, police believed the cases were linked. But they didn't know how.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scattered Clues
programme.desc: There's never a good reason for murder, but some killers are particularly brutalchoosing their prey at random or with no apparent motive and then cunningly covering their tracks. Even so, telltale clues remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Compulsion
programme.desc: Forensic psychologists delve into the minds of serial killers, explaining why, most often, they can be a friendly neighbor or the tenacious co-worker: the one who hides his or her dark side better than anyone else.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead In The Water
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Toxic Death
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Short Fuse
programme.desc: Explosives Investigations: The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which was mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid, the box exploded, killing her instantly.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Human Animal
programme.desc: The naked body of a vibrant young mother is found frozen solid in a deserted cemetery. Kenda reopens the investigation and recognizes the sinister hallmark of a serial killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Trigger
programme.desc: A sharp-dressed pedestrian is shot in the back for unknown reasons. Chasing a promising lead, Kenda realizes he’s barking up the wrong tree.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Loose Cannon
programme.desc: In the dead of night, a shooter on a rampage rips through a home, leaving a grandmother disfigured, her 24 year old daughter dead, and a two year-old child clinging to life.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Death Grip
programme.desc: When a speeding truck crashes into a residential building, officers find the lifeless body of Michael Faast behind the wheel. But he didn’t die in the wreck – he was shot point-blank in the temple.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: After School Special
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes when a beloved teacher is poisoned in her classroom. As doctors fight to save Barbara Lewis’ life, Lt. Joe Kenda and his team delve into her personal affairs.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: 12 Years a Fugitive
programme.desc: When a beloved grandmother is found stabbed to death in her own home, Kenda must turn to a tight-knit community still grieving from the tragic loss.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Night Fire
programme.desc: The Northern Lights are more than just beautiful; they tell us about the make up of our planet, our sun, and may even be a signpost for the possibility of life on other planets.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Virtual Universe
programme.desc: Our understanding of the cosmos is limited by the amount of time we have to see it. Fortunately, computer simulations can help us see how galaxies interact over millions of years, and even how dark matter structures the universe.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 5: Space Missions
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 6: Fermi paradox
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Puerto Rico, a band of extremists waged a guerrilla war against the United States. Their goal, to make the island an independent nation, or die trying.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980s the drug trade ravaged Chicago's inner city neighborhoods. Heroin and cocaine sales soared. Violent crime threatened to destroy the community.

programme.title: Tourist Police: Goa
programme.desc: Follows the Tourist Police based in India’s smallest state – and the Goan police have their hands full.

programme.title: Tourist Police: Magaluf
programme.desc: The police on the Spanish island of Majorca have their hands full as they face the full force of tourists abroad.

programme.title: Tourist Police: Thailand
programme.desc: We head east and join the Thai police as more tourists are in trouble.

programme.title: Tourist Police: Tenerife
programme.desc: We join the Tourist Police braving the notorious “Veronica’s Strip” in the hedonistic and violent Playa Las Americas..

programme.title: Tourist Police: Turkey
programme.desc: We join the Turkish Tourist Police who have a reputation for being tough.

programme.desc: Jury Room will debate the case of Michael Stone, a cold-hearted killer or an innocent suffering a miscarriage of Justice?

programme.title: Cops: Carjacked Up
programme.desc: Officers spot a suspect running down the street with a knife, the driver of a stolen car takes off on foot after he's pulled over, and police find carjacked vehicles.

programme.title: Cops: No Helmet, No Ride
programme.desc: A man resisting arrest draws a crowd, an armed robbery suspect takes a walk down felony lane with an officer he recognizes, and a strange scene unfolds at a DUI checkpoint.

programme.title: Cops: Sidewalk Licker
programme.desc: A prostitution sting in Las Vegas nets more than just johns, police respond to reports of a woman licking the sidewalk, and a patrol happens on a lovers' row in a parking lot.

programme.title: Cops: From Sixty to Zero
programme.desc: A motorcyclist fleeing police slams into a pickup truck at high speed, and a man being frisked invents an interesting story to explain the suspicious bulge in his pants.

programme.title: Cops: First Time Caller
programme.desc: A fleet-footed deputy nabs a suspect on the run, officers responding to a domestic call are refused entry, and police try to ascertain the cause of a woman's hallucinations.

programme.title: Cops: Kicking and Screaming
programme.desc: An intoxicated man suspected of domestic abuse refuses to obey deputies' orders, police find drugs in a woman's car, and an alleged prostitute encounters the police.

programme.title: Cops: Mixed Emotions
programme.desc: A traffic stop escalates to a dangerous situation, a woman admits to hitting her dad in the face with her teeth, and a defiant driver doesn't want deputies to search his car.

programme.title: Cops: Better Safe Than Sorry
programme.desc: Officers try to calm an agitated and disoriented man before he hurts himself or someone else, and a driver going 2 MPH on a highway catches the attention of a patrol car.

programme.title: Cops: Funny Money
programme.desc: Cops pursue a man skipping bail, an impaired driver is surprisingly cooperative, and officers struggle to remove a violent offender from a crime scene.

programme.title: Cops: Pants Down, Hit the Ground
programme.desc: A man learns a hard lesson about wearing his seatbelt, and police perform a traffic stop and uncover a sad man with a strange story.

programme.title: Cops: British Invasion
programme.desc: A desperate trespasser attempts to give the cops the slip, and a frightened man tries to get the attention of deputies but takes the wrong approach.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Jean-Raymond Blatti Case
programme.desc: Arriving at her work, the secretary of a small firm in the suburbs of Geneva finds the body of Jean-Raymond Blatti, the company's new accountant. The man is lying in a pool of blood and, on his belly, the murderer has written \"DIRTY RAPIST\".

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: A Very Strange Suicide (Muller case)
programme.desc: Police in Strasbourg receive a startling emergency call from Doctor Jean-Louis Muller, a forensic pathologist well known in the region.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Christophe Lejard Case
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home. The man was shot in the head as he was getting into his car to go to work. An execution, which at first glance doesn't square with the profile of a quiet family man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Deathly Fatal Passion At the Hotel (Villermet case)
programme.desc: The body of Nathalie Villermet, 46, manager of a small hotel and -restaurant, is found by a walker in the woods outside Paris, hidden under branches.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 103
programme.desc: To turgåere finner et utbrent lik på et bål langs en øde skogsbilvei på Veståsen i Søndre Land. I flere uker står politiet helt uten svar på hvem som kan stå bak den groteske handlingen.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 104
programme.desc: 10. august 2019 opplevde Norge nok et rystende terrorangrep. 21 år gamle Philip Manshaus dreper først sin 17 år gamle stesøster. Bevæpnet, og med uniform går han deretter til angrep mot Al-Noor moskeen i Bærum.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 105
programme.desc: Tina Jørgensen forsvant etter en kveld på byen i Stavanger. En måned senere finner politiet liket av en 20 år gammel kvinne. Hvem kan ha tatt livet av Tina og deretter dumpet henne langs en øde veistrekning?

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker: Episode 601
programme.desc: Den 14. november 2019 forsvinner sytten år gamle Wilma, og hele Uddevalla blir involvert i forsvinningen. Etter noen dager blir det funnet blod i hennes og kjærestens leilighet, men Wilma er fortsatt savnet.

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker: Episode 602
programme.desc: En regnfull morgen den 19. oktober 2004 dreper en ukjent mann en åtte år gammel gutt og en 56 år gammel kvinne i Linköping. Gjerningsmannen forsvinner sporløst og politiet må nå finne ut hvem han er.

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker: Episode 603
programme.desc: Politiet har ikke gitt opp å oppklare dobbeltdrapet i Linköping. Etter en endring i svensk lov i 2019, har politiet nå muligheten til å bruke kommersielle slektsdatabaser for å finne gjerningsmannen.

programme.desc: På romstasjonen oppdager Captain Man og Kid Danger at en liten jente har tatt astronautene til fange. Når de skjønner at astronautene gjør eksperimenter på kaniner, bestemmer de seg for å hjelpe henne.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fare på Dobbel Date
programme.desc: Når niesen til frøken Shapen, Noelle, kommer til byen og velger Jasper og ikke Henry, oppdager Henry at Noelle har større planer enn bare å gå ut på middag med Jasper.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Lisens til å fly
programme.desc: Ray gir Harvey lov til å fly helikopteret hans, men så blir det for mye for Ray og han begynner å oppføre seg som en nervøs forelder. Charlotte, Jasper og Piper finner en sukkerspinn-maskin i Skrot & Sånn og starter å lage sukkerspinn.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Swellviews Talenter
programme.desc: Når de oppdager at deltagerne på Swellviews Talenter mister bevisstheten, må Captain Man og Kid Danger få hjelp av Charlotte og Schwoz for å finne ut hva som er årsaken til at det skjer.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Sittende fast i hull
programme.desc: HVAAAA?! Captain man og Kid Danger sitter begge fast i et hull? Charlotte og Jasper er nødt til å hjelpe for Scwoz tar et bønnebad.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Dommedagens Ballonger
programme.desc: Når Dr. Minyak kidnapper fansen til The Man, må Captain Man og Kid Danger finne en måte å redde dem på uten at Dr. Minyak ser at de beveger seg.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Live og Farlig Del 1
programme.desc: Captain Man og Kid Danger blir invitert på party av en kjent Internett-kjendis, men når de ankommer oppdager de at selskapet ikke er hva det ser ut som det er. I mellomtiden er Charlotte barnevakt for Piper.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Live & Dangerous: Del 2
programme.desc: Frankini har annonsert sin plan om å finne ut hvem Kid Danger og Captain Man er. Charlotte, Schwoz, Jasper og Piper må slå seg sammen for å stoppe Frankini før identiteten til Kid Danger og Captain Man's blir avslørt for alle!

programme.title: Henry Danger: Game Dangers del 1
programme.desc: Frustrert over sine feilslåtte skurkestreker planlegger Dr. Minyak og ødelegge den verdensomspennende veldedighetskonserten til Double G. Captain Man, Kid Danger og Game shakers slår seg sammen for å overvinne Dr Minyak og holde Double G trygg.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Walinda / Valpene Redder et Stort Bein
programme.desc: Paw Patrol planlegger en spesiell feiring av Wally. Når han ikke kommer, må de finne hans spesielle venn Walinda. // Under Cap'n Turbots arkeologiske utgraving kommer et dinosaurbein til syne etter et steinras.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Elefantfamilie / Valpene og de Slemme Kattene
programme.desc: Valpenes kjøretur over savannen blir til en redningsaksjon og en familiegjenforening for en elefantfamilie. // Valpene må redde Adventure bukta fra de slemme kattene for å vinne en stor premie.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene lar Marshall Være Alene Hjemme / Valpene Redder Hjortefamilien
programme.desc: Når de andre valpene er på fallskjermtrening må Marshall få en gruppe med kattunger tilbake helt alene. // Ryder og PAW Patrol redder en hjortefamilie som sitter fast på den glatte isen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Venn / Valpene Redder en Blindpassasjer
programme.desc: Når Marshall bestemmer seg for å ta en pause fra Paw Control, slår valpene seg sammen for å få ham tilbake igjen. // Når Valpene finner en blindpassasjer på reisen til tundraen, må de redde en rømt kattunge i en rømt snowcat.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Den Nye Valpen
programme.desc: PAW Patrol rykker ut for å redde Jake når han blir strandet i isødet, men en ny valp dukker også opp for å gi en hjelpende pote: den modige Everest!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder et Bryllup / Valpene Redder Ace
programme.desc: Farmer Al og Farmer Yumi skal gifte seg! // Favoritt stuntpiloten til Skye, Ace Soarenson, er på vei til Adventure Bukta for å ha et fantastisk flyoppvisning. Like før ankomst får hun motorproblemer!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Papegøye / Valpene Redder Dronningbien
programme.desc: PAW Patrol drar ut i jungelen for å hjelpe vennen Carlos med å finne papegøyen Mateo som har blitt borte. // Ryder og PAW Patrol må hjelpe Cap'N Turbot å flytte bikubene over til et sted som er trygger for dem.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Voff og Roll-showet / Valpene Redder en ørn
programme.desc: Når en stor pop-stjerne kommer til byen, ødelegger en storm hele byen og scenen. Klarer Paw Patrol å redde dagen? // Mens de er i skogen redder valpene en ørn som sitter fast i reiret sitt.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene redder dykkerklokka / Valpene redder beverne
programme.desc: Mens Turbotene dykker, blir en av dykkerklokkene sittende fast. PAW Patrol må redde dem! // En storm vasker vekk beverdammen, så han tygger opp hele skogen til farmer Yumi. PAW Patrol kommer for å hjemmelaget ham med å bygge et nytt hus.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder et Talentshow / Valpene Redder Maisfesten
programme.desc: Det er dagen for Adventure Bukta's Talentshow ! Ordfører Goodway er spent, men redd det ikke vil være nok fremføringer! // Ryder og Pups hjelper Farmer Al å forberede den årlige Maiskolbe-stekingen som blir komplett med en Maiskolbe-labyrint!

programme.title: iCarly: A date en pøbel del 1
programme.desc: Når Carly dater er en tøffing, prøver hun å holde forholdet skjult for Spencer. Og Sam betaler Freddie for å lage en hjemmeside der hun kan legge ut alle sine ekle videofavoritter.

programme.title: iCarly: Gjenforening med Missy
programme.desc: Da Carlys gamle venninne Missy flytter tilbake til Seattle, tror Sam at Missy prøver å skifte henne ut som Carlys bestevenninne.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg må ha skap 239
programme.desc: Når Sam og Freddie begge to vinner konkurransen for skolens beste skap, slir de nødt til å dele skap. Carly ber Spencer gi henne timer i billedkunst.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly utdelingen
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie holder en iCarly-galla for de beste bruker-bidragene i iCarly, og hyller pristagerne live på web-showet. Spencer verver europeiske badedraktmodeller for å hjelpe ham å lage premiestatuettene.

programme.title: iCarly: Tvillinger
programme.desc: Freddie prøver å bevise at Melanie, Sams tvillingesøster, er Sam i forkledning. Når Carly underviser Spencers nemesis, Chuck, prøver Spencer å overbevise henne om at Chuck er ond.

programme.title: iCarly: A date en pøbel del 2
programme.desc: Når Carly oppdager at hennes tøffe kjæreste Griffin samler på små Pee Wee Babies, må hun ta stilling til om hun holder ut å date en kar som har en kosedyrsamling. I mens forsøker Spencer å hjelpe Sam med å bli kvitt et mareritt.

programme.title: iCarly: iKamp mot Dingo
programme.desc: Dingo-kanalen har stjålet idéer fra iCarly, så Carly, Sam, Freddie og Spencer drar til Dingos Studio for å fortelle manusforfatterne hva de mener om det.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg tror de kysset
programme.desc: Da Sam kommer til å avsløre overfor Carly at hun og Freddie smugkysset, konfronterer Carly dem med hvorfor de ikke fortalte henne om det. Og Spencer underviser fanger i billedkunst i fengselet.

programme.title: iCarly: Kokkekamp
programme.desc: Når Carl, Sam og Freddie vinner over en berømt tv-kokk i en matlagningskonkurranse, vil ikke kokken lage mat mer og nekter å komme ut av soverommet sitt. Spencer prøver å oppfylle en fremtidsdrøm.

programme.title: iCarly: Rektor kampen
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie får rektor Franklin sparket, overtar miss Briggs og mr. Howard ledelsen og innfører strenge regler. Og Spencer leier en gammel rodeostjerne til å lære ham å ri på en mekanisk okse.

programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt uvenner med Tamara og Ming, syns Jenna at det ikke spiller noen rolle hva hun gjør lenger - og hun havner i en vanskelig situasjon.

programme.title: Awkward: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
programme.desc: Val ber Mr Harts klasse om å skrive og framføre et eget skuespill, og moralen i historien virker svært kjent.

programme.desc: Etterdønningene etter Jennas krangel med vennene gjør at hun går ut en kveld. Men det som skulle bli en kveld for å lette på trykket blir en kveld hun må reddes fra.

programme.title: Awkward: The Campaign Fail
programme.desc: Det er på tide at Jenna kommer inn på rett spor igjen, men hun har forårsaket mer skade for sine nærmeste enn det som kan rettes opp med litt PR. Vil de tilgi henne, eller må hun ta i bruk drastiske midler?

programme.title: Awkward
programme.desc: Jenna og jentene er venner igjen og Jenna tror at hun er klar for å gjenoppta kjærlighetsaffæren med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Karmic Relief
programme.desc: Jenna håper at hvis hun retter opp sine feil ved å hjelpe Val med å få tilbake jobben sin, vil universet belønne henne med å sørge for at hun og Matty blir sammen igjen.

programme.title: Awkward: Who I Want To Be
programme.desc: Jenna utfordres til å sette spørsmålstegn ved hvem hun vil være i denne episke sesongfinalen.

programme.title: Awkward: Most Awkward Moments
programme.desc: En pinlig stund venter når vi tar en titt på de beste klippene fra 'Awkward' der skuespillerne selv kommenterer de morsomste replikkene, de saftigste forholdene og mye mer fra deres favorittepisoder av Awkward.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Slap-Ass: In Recovery

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 316

programme.title: Melrose Place: Stridens sirkel
programme.desc: Michael frir til Kimberly igjen, og hun får ham til å gi Sydney sparken fra firmaet. Men Sydney slår tilbake med et søksmål.

programme.desc: Alison nekter å gå ned til Billys nivå for å skaffe en ny klient, men hun hopper i søla på en strippeklubb for å få det til uansett.

programme.desc: Walter må svømme gjennom de dødelige La Brea-tjæregropene mens teamet hjelper en kvinne som sitter fast i tjæren før hun går tom for oksygen.

programme.title: Scorpion: Wreck the Halls

programme.title: Scorpion: The Hole Truth

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Smoking Ton
programme.desc: WW2 Stuart M3 tank barrel and heavy duty tank treads; rare, collectors' 1890 silver inlayed humidor; high-end industrial meat slicer in the ultimate restaurant unit.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Voodoo Moola
programme.desc: Allen & Ton hit a storage auction in Louisiana's Capitol City and quickly find themselves in trouble with the law! The guys uncover a pair of racing lawnmowers and then stumble on an antique barber chair from the early 1900s!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Diesel Digs
programme.desc: The guys head to the industrial hub of LA to score some heavy machinery and unearth a 1981 Bobcat 743 Frontloader, one of the first powered by a diesel engine and a trench-defending WWI German Sturmtrupp helmet bashing mace.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hidden Hot Wheels
programme.desc: Ton and Allen challenge a big time auction buyer on his home turf. The guys uncover a 1969 Chevelle Malibu muscle car and a single-shot pistol designed to aid Allied resistance fighters during WWII.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Real Thing

programme.title: Auction Hunters: High Flying Ton
programme.desc: A nerdy auction buyer tests Ton and Allen's patience at a big container auction in Ventura. The guys discover a basket and burners for a hot air balloon and a 19th century German single shot rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Viva la Vegas
programme.desc: 1974 death-defying Zig Zag magic sword box, an ultra-rare 1910 poster of the infamous magician Chung Ling Soo, an 1800s naval cane sword and century-old Metlach German beer steins.

programme.desc: Ton & Allen encounter aggressive outdoorsmen in the Alaskan wilderness. The guys discover an 8-wheeled ATV that travels on both land & water and an air percussion hammer that can drill through solid rock!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Night of the Digging Dead
programme.desc: A custom-built shark cage; 1900s pathologist's dissection toolkit; 1940s embalming pump and one of the first electric bone saws.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Rodeo Ton
programme.desc: 1970s El Toro mechanical bull used to train bull riders; silver WWII era banjo; a collection of 1800s handcrafted hunting duck decoys.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Drumming Up Cash
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face some silent but deadly competition at an auction in nearby Glendale. They discover a Zildjian brand percussion cymbal from the 1940's and a pyrotechnics control board designed for large-scale fireworks displays!

programme.title: Forensic Files: Walking Terror
programme.desc: A neighbor watched as a man stabbed his wife, pushed her into the swimming pool and held her head under water. The husband, however, had no recollection of the crime. A jury would have to decide between evidence and the mysteries of the mind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Marked for Life
programme.desc: It would take 46 years, handwriting analysis and new fingerprint technology to solve the 1957 murders of two California police officers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Puzzle
programme.desc: A man riding a bicycle was fatally injured in what police believed to be a hit-and-run accident. Tiny clues found at the scene created a picture of the vehicle which struck him and led police to its driver.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: When an elderly couple died in a suspicious house fire, their son became the prime suspect. Investigators turned to forensic science to determine if the fire had been set deliberately, or if it was an unfortunate accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soiled Plan
programme.desc: Police instituted an intense search when the mother of two young children went missing. Twenty years after her body was found, new technology recontextualized old evidence and pointed directly to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Headquarters
programme.desc: When hunters reported finding a skull in a Texas canyon, police immediately began an investigation. With a forensic artist's reconstruction, police eventually learned the victim's identity. Now all they had to do was find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: One for the Road
programme.desc: A married couple decided to escape the cold of winter with a mini-vacation in Key West. The wife went missing and police searched every square inch of the island; they found nothing but a pair of sandals which might have belonged to her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Army of Evidence
programme.desc: A mother of two young children was found dead in her bedroom. Her death was ruled a suicide — but when investigators learned she had almost died in a house fire three years earlier, they decided to take another look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shear Luck
programme.desc: In 1991, when the wife of a serviceman was brutally murdered in the Philippines, investigators had to reassemble a tiny computer disk that had been cut to pieces in order to find the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tagging a Suspect
programme.desc: Bombings are difficult to solve because the perpetrator isn't usually at the scene and the evidence goes up in smoke. In this case, pieces of plastic the size of grains of sand hold the key to finding a murderer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Strong Impressions
programme.desc: The wife of an Air Force officer was found dead in her bed with a plastic laundry bag near her face. Further investigation proved that the scene had been staged. Her death wasn't an accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In a small Ohio community, an elderly woman and a teenaged boy disappeared. Because they vanished within hours of each other, police believed the cases were linked. But they didn't know how.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brotherhood of Hate
programme.desc: In 1984, a tragic murder led agents into the frightening world of domestic terrorism. Law enforcement vowed to dismantle the violent faction that claimed responsibility.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Short Fuse
programme.desc: Explosives Investigations: The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which was mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid, the box exploded, killing her instantly.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Remnant of Blame
programme.desc: The solution to the most heinous crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Investigators must have their eyes trained to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shreds of Evidence
programme.desc: Hairs and Fibers: The tiniest filament can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways. Investigators have come to rely on forensic evidence as fine as a carpet fiber or as innocent as an eyelash to crack difficult cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Drawing Conclusions
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written in Blood
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: 12 Years a Fugitive
programme.desc: When a beloved grandmother is found stabbed to death in her own home, Kenda must turn to a tight-knit community still grieving from the tragic loss.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Poker Face
programme.desc: A group of friends discover the corpse of entrepreneur Jamie Foster hidden under a blanket. Kenda e discovers that Foster’s business put him in close quarters with a host of unsavory characters.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Uninvited Guest
programme.desc: A soldier is stabbed to death at a drive-thru. Kenda’s only clue is that this is somehow tied to a breakdancing competition.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Who Took Heather?
programme.desc: A 13-year-old girl is missing, sending Kenda’s city into a panic. A cryptic letter to the District Attorney’s office suggests the girl isn’t the only victim.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bad Blood
programme.desc: A army vet is found bleeding to death on the asphalt of a parking lot -- his chest littered with too many knife wounds to count. Kenda’s case is stuck in first gear until a gruesome clue appears.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 6: Fermi paradox

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Space: Getting There
programme.desc: The new surge in space transportation, privately owned companies vying for government contracts and private entrepreneurs looking to build hotels in space.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: My Family and The Galapagos: Episode 1
programme.desc: Monty Halls and family return to the Galapagos to aid a Giant Tortoise study and Tam goes in search of Giant Manta Rays.

programme.title: The Mind of the Universe: The Dreamer
programme.desc: It is through our wildest dreams that we achieve new knowledge. We see dreams of feeding the world with insects, dreams of a synthesis of the fundamental theories of physics, and dreams of our future as extra-terrestrials.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: The Sulmona Trail
programme.desc: Monty follows the route taken by prisoner of war Len Harley, who spent months on the run before braving snow, ice, and Nazi patrols to escape over the mountains of the Majella in Italy.

programme.title: Myth Hunters
programme.desc: In WWII's final days, Nazis hid evidence of their crimes. SS officers transported boxes to Austria's remote Lake Toplitz, witnessed dumping them on May 1, 1945. Rumors. Rumors claimed the boxes held stolen gold, part of a $500M Nazi heist.

programme.title: Ancient Black Ops: Spartans
programme.desc: Ancient Greece faces a Persian invasion, relying on their elite Spartan 300. At Thermopylae, they hold off the Persians for two days. The Krypteia allegedly attempt to assassinate the Persian Emperor as the Spartans fight to the last man.

programme.title: Aircrash Confidential
programme.desc: Aircrash Confidental explores aviation's battle with engineering errors, from DC10 disasters to Jumbo Jet's explosion. Despite Boeing 747's safety, TWA Flight 800's 1996 explosion reveals risks. The industry learns, improving safety in modern aircraft.

programme.title: On the Case: Deceiving Appearances
programme.desc: Police suspect a mysterious double homicide is not what it appears to be.

programme.title: On the Case: Mixed Signals
programme.desc: Cell phone records may help solve the disturbing murder of a popular teenager.

programme.title: On the Case: Unfinished Journey
programme.desc: Jamie Bowie disappears while driving from Phoenix to Los Angeles on Interstate 10, then her body is found near the highway a month later.

programme.title: On the Case: Deadly Predator
programme.desc: A sexual predator viciously murders a 16 year old girl. Can investigators catch him before he kills again?

programme.title: On the Case: Dirty Secrets
programme.desc: How did seventeen year old Joanna Rogers disappear from her home in the middle of the night? It was a question that baffled the investigators in Lubbock, TX. The mystery may have never been solved without the evidence found during another brutal murder...

programme.title: On the Case: Deadly Deception
programme.desc: Officers investigate the death of a father of four who was gunned down, however nothing about the crime is what it appears to be.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: The River Lift

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ski Plane

programme.title: Henry Danger: Game Dangers del 3
programme.desc: Frustrert over sine feilslåtte skurkestreker planlegger Dr. Minyak og ødelegge den verdensomspennende veldedighetskonserten til Double G. Captain Man, Kid Danger og Game shakers slår seg sammen for å overvinne Dr Minyak og holde Double G trygg.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Syk og Overvåket
programme.desc: I den troen at Henry ikke forteller hele sannheten når han er syk, plasserer Ray kameraer og mikrofoner i huset til Henry for å ta ham i å lyve.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Slosskampen
programme.desc: Når Charlotte blir utfordret til en slosskamp på skolen må Captain Man og Kid Danger hjelpe henne med å forsvare seg.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Steinboksdumpingen
programme.desc: Når en rapport som kommer ut konkluderer med at superkreftene til Kid Danger er en sykdom, må Kid Danger overbevise Solsyn om at det er en stor misforståelse.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fortidens Fremtid Del 1
programme.desc: Når Drex flykter gjennom Tidsportalen til Time Jerker, må Henry og Ray dra tilbake til fortiden for å stoppe ham, før han permanent endrer fortiden til Ray.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fortidens Fremtid Del 2
programme.desc: Når Drex forandrer unge Ray, må Henry, og nå destruktive, Ray, kjempe mot Drex og få Ray tilbake til normalen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Gummiand
programme.desc: Når Ray, ved et uhell, ødelegger den fjernstyrte bilen til faren til Henry, har de et manikyr/pedikyr-selskap for å tjene penger til å fikse den.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kutt i Budskjettet
programme.desc: Når viseordføreren kutter i budsjettet til Captain Man og Kid Danger for å bygge et høyhastighetstog, må Captain Man og Kid Danger finne kreative måter å spare penger på.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tegneserien
programme.desc: Når Henry og Ray får en kopi av den nye Kid Danger og Captain Man tegneserien og ser at den er forferdelig, må de forte seg og fikse tegneserien før det store premiereselskapet.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Biltur
programme.desc: Bursdagsbilturen til Charlotte for å se Bo Man Group opptre, blir utsatt på grunn av en 'Captain Man og Kid Danger'-nødsituasjon.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder et Talentshow / Valpene Redder Maisfesten
programme.desc: Det er dagen for Adventure Bukta's Talentshow ! Ordfører Goodway er spent, men redd det ikke vil være nok fremføringer! // Ryder og Pups hjelper Farmer Al å forberede den årlige Maiskolbe-stekingen som blir komplett med en Maiskolbe-labyrint!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder et Romvesen / Valpene Redder en Flyvefrosk
programme.desc: Et romskip krasjlander hos Farmer Yumi! // Nå er det opp til PAW Patrol å hjelpe romvesenet ved å fikse skipet hans og få ham tilbake til hjemplaneten sin!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Jake / Valpene Redder Paraden
programme.desc: Jake og Chase er dypt inne i en hule når Jake klarer å sette fast ankelen mellom noen steiner // Adventure Bukta's Paradedag går galt når Alex fester for mange ballonger på badekar-flåten til Katie. Den bokstavelig talt 'flyter' bort!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Ordfører-konkurransen / Valpene Redder Tyvegodset
programme.desc: Det er det årlige ordfører-racet og Ordfører Humdinger legger planer for den verste juksingen noensinne // Når Ryder kommer over et gammelt skattekart, stjeler Ordfører Humdinger kartet for å finne skatten selv.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Grynterne / Valpene og Spøkelseshytta
programme.desc: En sykedag hos Paw Patrol? Mens Rubbel og Ryder leter etter grisene til Al, må Marshall passe på de snufsete valpene // Først forsvinner lunchen til Rubbel, så er lunch-boksen til Jake borte. Er det et spøkelse?

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Bjeffer med Dinosaurer
programme.desc: Valpene er på en utgraving når de graver ut tre fossile egg. Plutselig begynner eggene å klekke og snart er det tre pterodactyler som løper rundt i Adventure Bukta. Nå er det opp til Paw Patrol å fange dinosaurene.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder et Spøkelse / Valpene Redder en Forestilling
programme.desc: Et mystisk spøkelse forårsaker kaos om natten. Valpene og Chase sitter på vakt for å fange det, men oppdager at det ikke er et spøkelse i det hele tatt. // Valpene skal sette opp på et Middelalderskuespill i bytorget, men så kollapser scenen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Flyndra og Francois / Valpene Redder Pingvinene
programme.desc: Cap'n Turbot og Francois er ute og ser etter hvaler når Flyndra treffer en stein og begynner å synke. Denne redningsaksjonen krever alle labber på dekk. // Pop-up pingviner er plassert over hele Adventure Bukta. På tide å ringe Paw Patrol!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Snøbrett-konkurranse / Valpene Redder en Høne til Sjøs
programme.desc: Jake og Everest gleder seg til snøbrett-konkurransen inntil de ser at hele løypa er dekket av snø. // Når Paw Patrol drar for å finne dykkerklokken til Cap'n Turbot som har sunket, møter de en gigantisk sjøsnegle.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Speidertur / Valpene Redder en Overraskelse

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: Great Moments in Hookup History & Ask a Black Dude

programme.title: Tosh.0: Bryan Adams Kid
programme.desc: Daniel viser fram sin Halloween-drakt og hjelper til med å fange et internettmonster. Dessuten får en kjærlighedssyk teenager gjenoppreisning.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Pikespeider-tyver
programme.desc: Daniel taler solskinnsstatens heteste kriminelles sak, får staben til å spise eksklusiv dyremat og starter en ny sportsliga.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Taxi Dave
programme.desc: Daniel feirer Thanksgiving med sine fans og den rappende taxisjåføren får gjenoppreisning.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Virgin Trampoline Jumper
programme.desc: Daniel hjelper en jomfru med å sjekke og introduserer dere for de aller sinteste damene i USA.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Season Four Web Reflection
programme.desc: Med sylskarp humor og bitende kommentarer, fører komikeren Daniel Tosh oss inn i alle aspekter av Internett, fra det helt absurde til det geniale, i denne ukentlige serien med forkjellige tema.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Gingers Have Souls
programme.desc: I sesongpremieren utfører Daniel og hans personale sportsutfordringer, han sender et våget bilde til en fremmed og Michael - en fyr som blir mobbet for å være rødhåret - får gjenoppreisning på nettet.

programme.title: Tosh.0: X12 (CeWEBrity Profile)
programme.desc: Daniel feirer Valentinsdag med å la deg beklage deg over partneren din, og verdens eneste svarte superhelt får nettoppreisning.

programme.title: Tosh.0: The Oscars Spoiler Alerts
programme.desc: Daniel får workouttips til soverommet og avslører alt om filmene som er nominert til Oscar for Beste film.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Tosh.0 February 26, 2013 - Courtroom C**k Guy
programme.desc: The Courtroom C**k Guy gets a Web Redemption, Daniel tests out different slurs, and comedian Greg Hahn asks for medical advice.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Ventriloquist Fail
programme.desc: Daniel nekter å lage en 'Harlem Shake'-video, og Candice, buktaleren som forlot scenen, får gjenoppreisning på nettet.

programme.title: The Roast of William Shatner
programme.desc: The Roast of William Shatner ble nominert til en Primetime Emmy Award i 2007, i kategorien Outstanding Variety Special. Her blir skuespilleren plassert i rampelyset når roastmaster Jason Alexander og en gruppe komikere jekker ham ned noen hakk.

programme.title: The Roast of Alec Baldwin
programme.desc: Nå er det Alec Baldwins tur i den varme stolen, årets Roast Master er Sean Hayes, og blant de som roaster finner vi Robert De Niro, Caitlyn Jenner og Nikki Glaser.

programme.title: The Roast of Bruce Willis NO
programme.desc: Grillmester Joseph Gordon-Levitt og et panel som inkluderer Edward Norton, Nikki Glaser, Lil Rel Howery, Jeff Ross og flere benytter kvelden til å gjøre narr av action-legenden Bruce Willis.

programme.title: Full fräs – Hela serien
programme.desc: Redan från början var det mycket snus, brännvin och snusk. Man kan säga att det var Full Fräs från början... Här får man stifta bekantskap med Birger och Olvert och andra roliga typer…

programme.title: Virus i Bataljonen
programme.desc: På Ingeborgs café sitter de säregna byborna och fikar. In på caféet far plötsligt den hårdkokte norrlänningen kapten Carl Marklund. Bitter på nedskärningarna inom försvaret har han kommit till byn i jakten på Sveriges starkaste hemvärn.

programme.title: Hemsöborna
programme.desc: "Han kom som ett yrväder en aprilafton och hade ett höganäskrus i en svångrem om halsen." Så börjar August Strindbergs omtalade roman Hemsöborna. Så börjar också Lars och Krister Classons fria tolkning av densamma
